name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.67 / build 68 adds bidirectional typing indicators, first-name message labels, initials or clinic-logo avatars and relative message times. Matching desktop/backend sources use one alert per conversation with per-patient unread dots and the Your account / Alphastar Staff connection dropdown. Typing expires automatically and does not transmit draft text or create notifications. Historical authors and mobile conversations remain saved; website exit still ends the guest session. The Help Bot transcript and booking details are not automatically shared. Physical-phone installation and actual notification delivery are not verified. Existing development signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval.
